question.question: According to recommendation 1 (B1-1) in the 2021 ESPEN practical guideline Clinical Nutrition in cancer, which nutritional screening items should be evaluated, when should screening begin, and how should repeat assessment be timed?

options.A: Serum albumin, lymphocyte count and hemoglobin; begin only when chemotherapy starts and repeat once yearly.
options.B: Muscle mass, physical performance and inflammation only; begin after severe malnutrition develops and repeat at a fixed monthly interval.
options.C: Nutritional intake, weight change and BMI; begin at cancer diagnosis and repeat according to the stability of the clinical situation.
options.D: Calorie expenditure and micronutrient concentrations only; begin after treatment ends and repeat only on patient request.

action.justification: Based on the 2021 ESPEN practical guideline 'Clinical Nutrition in cancer', recommendation 1 (B1-1) specifies that nutritional screening should include nutritional intake, weight change, and BMI. Screening should begin at the time of cancer diagnosis and repeat assessments should be timed according to the stability of the patient's clinical situation.
